identitySignals: Name matches: Gelfand Partners Architects, a San Francisco architecture firm (own website; California filing listing shows the same name)

The firm's own project page for the Kaiser Early Childhood Development Center in Oakland, CA names Oakland Unified School District as client, matching the agenda's Kaiser Child Development Center Outdoor Learning Environment Project
Agenda gives San Francisco, CA and Oakland, CA; the firm is headquartered in San Francisco and works on Oakland school projects
Architecture and school-design services match OUSD's 'School buildings & construction' category and Facilities Planning and Management office
research.notes: One agenda title in the input ('Nonpublic, Nonsectarian School/Agency Services Master Contract 2022-23 – Speech Pathology Group') concerns a different vendor and appears to have been merged into this vendor record in error; it was ignored. The California entity number comes from a third-party mirror of the Secretary of State record (bizprofile.net), not the official bizfile site, which could not be fetched; a reviewer may wish to confirm it on bizfileonline.sos.ca.gov. No Oakland office is listed on the firm's website; the Oakland location in the agenda refers to the project site.

profile.summary: A San Francisco design firm that provides architecture, landscape architecture and interior design services. It works on schools, housing, community facilities and commercial spaces, including new buildings and reuse of existing ones. It is a Certified B Corporation.

sources.title: Gelfand Partners Architects San Francisco, CA - filing information
